import http.server, json, threading

class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_POST(self):
        n = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
        body = self.rfile.read(n).decode()
        json.loads(body)  # must be valid JSON
        self.send_response(201)
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(b'{"status": "accepted"}')
    def log_message(self, *a):
        pass

srv = http.server.HTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', 0), H)
port = srv.server_address[1]
t = threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True)

import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('sync', 'sync.py')
sync = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(sync)

records = sync.load_records()
accepted = sync.post_records(f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}/v2/records', records)
print(f'accepted {accepted}/{len(records)}')
assert accepted == len(records) == 3
srv.shutdown()
print('SELF-TEST PASSED')
